subject: ela
intro: Pick how the image helps you understand the text.

items.prompt:
A labeled diagram of a plant helps you understand:
A) the parts of the plant
B) the price of the book
C) the author's name
items.answer: A) the parts of the plant

steps: Labels show parts. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) the parts of the plant

items.prompt:
A map in a text mostly shows:
A) where things are
B) how to spell words
C) the glossary

steps: Maps show location. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A chart in a text helps you:
A) compare facts or numbers
B) draw pictures
C) find the cover

steps: Charts organize data. Key is A.

items.prompt:
The words say 'some animals are fast.' A chart shows a cheetah at 70 mph and a turtle at 1 mph. The chart:
A) gives exact speeds that support the words
B) changes the topic
C) adds nothing
items.answer: A) gives exact speeds that support the words

steps: Chart supports the point. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) gives exact speeds that support the words

items.prompt:
A diagram of the water cycle with arrows helps you see:
A) the steps and path of water
B) the book's price
C) the author's opinion
items.answer: A) the steps and path of water

steps: Shows the process. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) the steps and path of water

items.prompt:
A map's key (legend) explains the map's:
A) symbols
B) page number
C) title only

steps: Key explains symbols. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A photo shows a giant squid next to a person for size. This helps the reader understand:
A) exactly how big the squid is
B) where squids live
C) what squids eat
items.answer: A) exactly how big the squid is

steps: Comparison shows scale. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) exactly how big the squid is

items.prompt:
To find out which of three bridges is longest, the BEST feature is a:
A) bar chart of their lengths
B) glossary
C) caption
items.answer: A) bar chart of their lengths

steps: Charts compare amounts. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) bar chart of their lengths
